name: Hard Hat Cats
neighborhoods: All 5 boroughs - places un-adoptable feral cats as working cats at businesses
notes: Nonprofit (since ~2018, TNR roots 2008) placing feral/unadoptable cats from ACC + hoarding/colony situations as WORKING CATS (breweries, distilleries, warehouses, community gardens, apartment buildings) for non-toxic rodent deterrence. Cat is free; employer provides food/water/humane shelter. Has placed inside the Brooklyn Navy Yard (Kings County Distillery). Verified 2026-08-26. Intake: Businesses/sites apply via site or email Intake: founder does a site visit before placement Other channel: founder/president Sheila Massey
